name: @cyclone-ui/stack-trace
description: StackTrace, a failed tool call and its stack frames, built on Trace. It parses a JavaScript stack string (trace prop) into the error type, message and frames (function, file, line, column), and renders a danger line that reads "Failed: TypeError: ..." and opens (open, defaultOpen, onOpenChange) into the full error, your own frames as lines that call onFilePathClick, and the node_modules and Node internal frames folded into a dimmed monospace block. StackTraceActions and StackTraceCopyButton sit beside the line. parseStackTrace is exported.
